company.shortDescription: HeyClicky develops a Mac desktop AI assistant that guides workflows and automates on-screen and background tasks.
company.description: HeyClicky develops a Mac desktop AI assistant that lives next to the user’s cursor and interprets on-screen context and spoken requests. The application captures visual data from the Mac display and voice input to answer interface questions and guide users through software workflows. It supports creators, developers, and knowledge workers using complex tools by providing step-by-step assistance without leaving their active workspace. Through its agent capabilities, HeyClicky can launch background tasks to build software, research topics, manage files, or interact with other applications. The product also connects with native apps to handle actions such as managing notes, calendars, email, and reminders. HeyClicky focuses on reducing friction in everyday computer use through conversational, on-device assistance.
